name: Grace and Joy
body:
Your heart and soul are filled with the warmth of the Goddess of Pleasure and Song.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is the goddess of pleasure and song

Benefit: You gain a +2 divine bonus to any two Perform skills.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
